title: Setting Up Prisma Client
description: Create a singleton Prisma Client instance and configure it for Next.js server-side usage.

data.text: Prisma Client is auto-generated from your schema. In Next.js, it is important to create a singleton instance to avoid exhausting database connections during development and in serverless environments.

Next.js Server Components and API routes can be invoked many times. Without a singleton, each invocation would create a new Prisma Client instance, potentially exhausting your database connection pool.

data.title: Singleton Prisma Client
data.content: Create a singleton Prisma Client instance in lib/prisma.ts.

data.text: Import the singleton into server-side files and use it like any other database client. All queries are fully typed based on your schema.

data.title: Warning
data.text: Never create a new PrismaClient() inside a client component or a route handler that runs frequently without a singleton pattern. This can exhaust your connection pool.
